# Pellworth Analytics - ingest worker metrics

The ingest platform writes one row per worker and daily window to exports/worker-metrics-<month>.csv after the nightly rollup.

jobs_processed counts accepted batches, duration_ms is the worker's mean per-batch handling time for the window, and error_count counts rejected batches.
